projects.name: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 (Lines)
projects.notes: The service name says 2026_2030 (and misspells 'Progam') but the content is the FY 2027-2031 program. work_type_values listed are WK_SUB_CAT_DESC (9 values, best for filtering: Major Widening, Minor Widening, Reconstruction); WK_TYPE_DESC is finer; WK_CAT_DESC is Bridge/Road/System Operations/Traffic Safety. Only construction phases (PHASE_TYPE_ABBRV='CON'). Future work: ACTL_LET_DATE is null and SCHD_LET_DATE/PHASE_ANTCP_CNST_DATE are in the future; FSCL_YR runs 2023-2031 so some rows are already let. ANTCP_CNST_YRS lists construction years.

projects.name: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 (Points)
projects.notes: Point jobs (bridges, spot work) of the same program; same schema as the lines layer.

parcels_statewide_note: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found for Michigan.

parcels_counties.notes: City of Detroit open data, not the whole county. Name is the taxpayer of record. Assessed value is about half of market value in Michigan.
Macomb County Tax Parcels. Owner name only, no mailing address. mborsev_0 is the state equalized value (about half of market value); CVT_NAME is the city/township.
Genesee County Land Records and GIS, 2025 parcels. Separate taxpayer fields (TaxName, TaxStreet, TaxCity, TaxState, TaxZip). SEV is about half of market value.

parcels_counties.restrictions: possible limit, needs a human read: the county's GIS data disclaimer says 'Maps and data are to be used for reference purposes only'. The rest is an accuracy and liability disclaimer; nothing names commercial use, resale, solicitation or mailing lists.
parcels_counties.notes: Whole county, run by Lenawee County Equalization Department/GIS Division (owner DereckWilt, the county GIS technician named in the terms), item 08db5d2e5bc6460b839c9857edcf62d7 'Lenawee Parcels Public', copyrightText 'Lenawee County Michigan'; lastEditDate 2026-11-20. Terms read (licenseInfo, 'LENAWEE COUNTY GIS DATA DISCLAIMER'): 'The GIS material is made available as a public service. Maps and data are to be used for reference purposes only and Lenawee County, Michigan, is not responsible for any inaccuracies herein contained. No responsibility is assumed for damages or other liabilities due to the accuracy, availability, use or misuse of the information herein provided... NOT to be construed or used as a "legal description."... In no event will Lenawee County be liable for any damages...' - an accuracy/liability disclaimer; no limit on commercial use, resale, redistribution, solicitation or mailing lists stated. CAUTION for the caller: the phrase 'to be used for reference purposes only' is the only use wording; I read it as part of the accuracy disclaimer, judge for yourself. NO MAILING ADDRESS and no value field in the layer (owner names and site address only); OWNNM2 is a second owner line; ACRECALC is the GIS-computed acreage, ACREREC the recorded; STATUS field ('Active'); blanks are ' '. maxRecordCount 2000.

parcels_counties.notes: Whole county, run by Barry County (owner eroberts_countyofbarry), item ee1733789d6c4c7c84f88e66d1867620 'Parcels_PublicViewer_View', copyrightText 'Barry County', lastEditDate 2026-11-19. The layer does answer queries with owner fields without a login, but the county's stated terms are view-only. The county's separate 'Parcels (Open Data)' view (item cfb4f1c74e524cb1b0510ca46eb9758f) is freely licensed ('open data for public use, download, and redistribution') but its terms say 'This layer does not contain ownership, assessment, tax, or other restricted parcel information' and 'Full or partial parcel attribute datasets are available for purchase from Barry County Land Information Services (LIS) on a per-record basis.' No value field.

summary: Projects: MDOT Five-Year Transportation Program 2027-2031 lines and points verified, with work type, budget, STIP status and scheduled let dates. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; verified Detroit (Wayne), Macomb and Genesee; Oakland, Kent and the rest of Wayne not available free. Added 2026-11-21, all held: Lenawee, Eaton, Barry, and city or partial layers for Lansing, Farmington Hills, Battle Creek and north-east Livingston. Oakland and Kent county layers carry no owner names; no statewide owner layer.
